# Proconix PMC

> Proconix PMC — Sponsor-Aligned Construction Project Governance in Africa. Proconix PMC is an owner-side construction project delivery partner for real estate, hospitality and industrial project sponsors and investors with construction projects in Africa (East Africa first: Tanzania, Zanzibar, Kenya, Uganda, Zambia). We direct, manage and execute end-to-end construction project governance across the full EPCM lifecycle, from inception to successful handover, on projects from USD 5 million to over USD 100 million.

Founder: Talibbhai Khanji — Strategic Project Leader. P.Eng (Civil), ERB Tanzania & Zambia · MBA (Project Management) · PMP®, Project Management Institute, USA. 19+ years of multinational experience, of which 15+ years on the ground in Africa.

Deployment models: Full On-Site Governance Command™ · Hybrid Governance Model™ · Virtual Governance Control Room™.

Outcomes (as stated by Proconix): up to 20% cost savings; up to 97% on-time delivery; 15–20 executive hours reclaimed every week; zero major quality issues at handover across the projects Talibbhai Khanji has led; $250M+ of construction projects delivered.
